Cyber Safety at Machine Speed 

Our mission is Cyber Safety 

Safety is the feeling you have when you are free from harm.  

Cyber safety is not only about avoiding harm to ourselves, but to others as well.  

It is foundational to business growth.  

Keeping you safe at Machine Speed 

Our Safe XDR services enables you to be safe by continuously managing your cyber threat exposure.

60%

90% 

automation of security tasks 

Rapid Response: 

95% 

reduction in Mean Time to Remediate (MTTR) to less than 6 minutes 

Comprehensive Visibility and Transparency: 

100% 

visibility across your attack surface 

Independent from Skills Shortage: 

100% 

independence from skilled labour shortages
